replies.author: Minoli Fernando
replies.text:
Chamara Rathnayake This looks like a *real photo*, not AI-generated.

A few signs:
- Low resolution / blur and uneven lighting typical of an old phone selfie or a photo taken of another screen
- Natural skin texture and imperfect details, not the overly smooth look AI often makes
- No obvious AI artifacts like warped ears, extra fingers, or melted background

It's hard to be 100% certain from a low-quality image, but nothing here points to AI.

This is the truth This photo is not AI
Meta දාලා බලන්න
